verdict.rationale: Bolt documents connecting GitHub to back up a project with full commit history outside Bolt, and creating a new repository from a Bolt project, so code can be exported as a standard git repo. Choosing Supabase instead of Bolt Database offers tighter control over app data, and a cofounder states subscriptions can be cancelled at any time, which supports leaving. Missing for 10: any documented export of Bolt Database data, chat/prompt history or account data in open formats; a documented full-account export or offboarding path; independent hands-on confirmation of a clean exit.
